name: voice
title: Clip that
about: Say "simple clip that" (or "hey simple clip that") and it saves a clip. Works offline with Windows speech recognition.

settings.label: Show "Saving clip" first
settings.hint: The card shows up in the clip, then it saves 2 seconds later

settings.label: Beep when it hears you
settings.hint: The beep is in the clip too

settings.label: Sensitivity
settings.hint: Strict needs a clearer "simple clip that" and triggers by mistake less often
